brass-birmingham-2018.name: Brass: Birmingham

rounds.endCondition: Canal Era and Rail Era each end after all players use their last cards

categories.label: Final VP (score track)
categories.hint: VP marker after the Rail Era scoring; add 100 per lap. Link and industry VP are scored onto the track at the end of each era; shortfall penalties are already deducted.

categories.label: Income level (tiebreak)
categories.hint: Income level number, not income track space.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, those players draw.

brass-birmingham-2018.notes: VPs are only awarded at the end of each era (links first, then flipped industries; unflipped industries score nothing). Link tiles are removed as scored; level-1 industries are removed after canal era. If you enter the final VP marker position instead, use one number per era. Beyond 100 VP the track loops. Per-player scorers can record era subtotals via the four categories. Final score is the VP marker on the track: era scoring (links, flipped industries) and shortfall penalties move it during play, so no per-link or per-industry entry is needed.

brass-birmingham-2018.uiHintReason: Track marker already contains both era scorings; only income and money are extra for ties.
brass-birmingham-2018.winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Hòa: thu nhập cao hơn, rồi nhiều tiền hơn; vẫn hòa thì bốc thăm.

gaia-project-2017.name: Gaia Project
gaia-project-2017.variant: base (expansion The Lost Fleet not modelled)

categories.label: Victory points before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm VP trước khi tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: Marker on the VP track (starts at 10) after round 6.

categories.label: Final scoring tiles VP total
categories.labelVi: Tổng điểm 2 ô tính điểm cuối
categories.hint: VP from both final scoring tiles: 1st/2nd/3rd/4th = 18/12/6/0 each; ties split the VP of the shared ranks evenly.

categories.label: Research levels 3, 4, 5
categories.hint: Count each level 3, 4 and 5 reached or passed across all six tracks.

categories.label: Leftover credits + knowledge + ore
categories.hint: Total of credits, knowledge and ore; 1 VP per 3 in any combination.

gaia-project-2017.notes: Game ends after round 6. Final tiles come from: most structures in federations, most structures, most planet types, most Gaia planets, most sectors, most satellites. In 1-2 player games a neutral player's satellites occupy a rank, which can push the human players down a rank. Power/Q.I.C. and other resources do not convert to VP. Rank-based tile awards (with tie splitting) are entered as final VP rather than computed. The rulebook has no extra tiebreaker: tied players share victory. Lost Fleet extras (Lost Planet, Ivits) only affect what counts in final tiles.

gaia-project-2017.winConditionVi: Điểm cao nhất thắng. Hòa thì cùng thắng. Ván kết thúc sau vòng 6.

the-gang-2024.name: The Gang

rounds.endCondition: Game ends when the team has 3 successful heists or 3 failed heists (3 to 5 heists)

categories.label: Heist results (tick = success, cross = failure)
categories.labelVi: Kết quả từng phi vụ (✓ thành công, ✗ thất bại)
categories.hint: A heist succeeds when the chip order matches the hand ranking order at showdown; any mistake trips an alarm

the-gang-2024.winCondition: Each game has 3 to 5 heists of 4 rounds each. A heist succeeds if the final (red) chips are in the correct order of hand strength at the showdown; the team wins on 3 successful heists and loses on 3 failures. Advanced/Professional/Master Thief modes add challenge and specialist cards (not modelled).
the-gang-2024.notes: family: coop. No points. Difficulty rises with player count. Advanced/Professional modes add an extra showdown requirement (guessing hand rank).

sources.title: The Gang Review: High-Stakes Cooperative Poker

the-gang-2024.winConditionVi: Mỗi ván có 3-5 phi vụ. Cả đội thắng khi đạt 3 phi vụ thành công, thua khi dính 3 phi vụ thất bại. Chỉ cần ghi kết quả từng phi vụ.
the-gang-2024.uiHintReason: Heist strip: tap success/failure per heist, auto-stop at 3 wins or 3 losses.
